name: solon-of-clauses
description: Solon of Clauses: an MCP agent that checks a contract (.docx, .txt or .md) against your own clause playbook, reports which clauses are present, missing, prohibited or need attention with section and line citations, flags open placeholders, broken cross-references and defined-term problems, compares two drafts clause by clause, and drafts an issues list for counsel using only your playbook's language. Sending or signing is a legally binding send: always one human click, and signing is blocked. Not legal advice and not a substitute for a lawyer.
author: Kurt Francisco
